blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla on Thursday called for the imposition of the death penalty on agricultural smugglers following a privilege speech by Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan seeking a committee inquiry into the seizure of around 20,000 metric tons of Vietnam rice worth an estimated P700 million. “Okay naman po ’yung kulungan, dapat talagang may makulong. Pero kung ganito pong klaseng mga tao na nasa loob ng sindikato, magbubuhay hari lang po ito sa loob,” Padilla said in a manifestation.
